technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Cloud Stream (s-c-s) as the target framework for porting modules from Spring XD.
Adapt each ported module to function as either a source or sink component in s-c-s as specified in user stories.
Ensure compatibility with Java 17+ and Spring Framework 6.0 for all developments.
Maintain backward compatibility where feasible, with clear documentation for migration from version 1.2 to 1.3.
Integrate with latest HDP/PHD distro releases for HDFS support, as required for U7.
assumptions: Access to source code repositories for both Spring XD and Spring Cloud Stream is available.
The modules to be ported (router, file, FTP, redis, rabbit, gemfire) are functional in XD and require adaptation to fit s-c-s architecture.
A development environment with necessary tools (e.g., IDE, build system, testing frameworks) is set up.
Effort estimates are based on a single developer's productivity, assuming no significant delays or external dependencies.
Testing, including unit and integration tests, is included in the effort for each module port.
The documentation for U8 assumes standard technical writing practices and access to release notes.

activities.activity_description: Port the router module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream, adapting it as a sink component. This involves analyzing existing code, refactoring, implementing sink binding, adding configuration, writing tests, and ensuring integration.
Port the file module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream, adapting it as a sink component. Similar steps as A1, focusing on file handling and sink integration.
Port the FTP module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream, adapting it as a sink component. Includes FTP-specific logic, connection management, and sink adaptation.
Move the redis module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream as a sink component. Involves Redis client integration, data serialization, and sink binding.
Move the rabbit module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream as a source component. Requires adapting RabbitMQ integration, message consumption, and source binding.
Move the gemfire module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream as a sink component. Involves GemFire configuration, data writing, and sink adaptation.

Update and test compatibility with the latest releases of HDP (Hortonworks Data Platform) and PHD (Pivotal HD) distros for HDFS integration. This includes dependency updates, configuration changes, and validation.
Document the migration strategy from Spring XD 1.2 to 1.3, covering new features, backward incompatibilities, and step-by-step guidance for users and developers.
